text: RESULTS: Mucosal ulcers are present on the buccal (mouth), gingival, and vulvar (genital) mucosa. The skin examination reveals multiple flaccid blisters on the volar surface of the forearm; while rupture status is not explicitly detailed, the presence of flaccid blisters and a positive Nikolsky sign indicates skin separation and raw areas upon slight friction. Skin Biopsy histopathology shows acantholysis and intraepidermal blister formation. Direct Immunofluorescence findings demonstrate intercellular IgG and C3 deposition within the epidermis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing acantholysis and intercellular IgG deposition strongly point to Pemphigus Vulgaris, a condition that can be triggered by medications like captopril.
